## Learning goal

I can generate several ideas, investigate existing solutions, and choose an idea using evidence.

<figure>
<img src="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1bQBt0WHBp6ca0RWtQHBHKbfqhzXMc4q4uUOJ8hHxvIQ/export/png?id=1bQBt0WHBp6ca0RWtQHBHKbfqhzXMc4q4uUOJ8hHxvIQ&amp;pageid=p5" alt="Investigate and Inquire stage of the N.I.C.E. process." style="display:block;max-width:960px;width:100%;margin-inline:auto">

## Go wide, then investigate

Brainstorm several different possibilities before researching. Use quick sketches, changed materials, different orientations, and **borrow, combine, adapt, improve** prompts.

Then ask four questions:

1. What do we need?
2. What already exists?
3. What could work for us?
4. What would we change?

Record what is good, what is a problem, and what still needs to be checked. Name the sources you used.

[Use the N.I.C.E. Inquiry Worksheet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c-7TbI3IMOicnHsTUSLkGNJ4s1i2OA6d458S2bTZ2ho/edit).
